sn22.10:1.2: “Bhikkhus, form is suffering, both of the past and the future,
sn22.10:1.3: not to speak of the present.
sn22.10:1.4: Seeing thus, bhikkhus, the instructed noble disciple is indifferent towards form of the past;
sn22.10:1.5: he does not seek delight in form of the future;
sn22.10:1.6: and he is practising for revulsion towards form of the present, for its fading away and cessation.
sn22.10:1.10: Consciousness is suffering, both of the past and the future,
sn22.10:1.11: not to speak of the present.
sn22.10:1.12: Seeing thus, bhikkhus, the instructed noble disciple is indifferent towards consciousness of the past;
sn22.10:1.13: he does not seek delight in consciousness of the future;
sn22.10:1.14: and he is practising for revulsion towards consciousness of the present, for its fading away and cessation.”
